items.label: E2E Networks Q2 FY2027 (10-16-2026)
items.signal_prefix: MD Tarun Dua: the next lot of 1,024 B200 GPUs

set.signal: MD Tarun Dua: the next lot of B200 GPUs, which E2E has already announced, is expected to go live this quarter ('hopefully soon'); nothing has been decided yet about contracting it; plans for B300 and Vera Rubin will be announced once they firm up. He sees no insurmountable GPU supply-chain challenges in the near or medium term and says the software is meant to be compatible with other chip makers' accelerators if customers require it.
set.figure: next lot of B200 GPUs expected to go live this quarter

items.reason: The GPU count '1,024' appears only in the article's summary at the top of the transcript (lines 9, 13, 47, 73), not in any management turn; the MD says only 'The next lot of B200, which we have already announced, is expected to go live this quarter.' Number removed, management's words kept.
items.evidence: Tarun Dua, Managing Director, E2E Networks Limited: Yeah. The next lot of B200, which we have already announced, is expected to go live this quarter. Hopefully soon.
